title: [BIP-933] Claim Timeless VeBalGrant USDC fees
body:
# TL;DR

After [BIP-925](https://forum.balancer.fi/t/bip-925-unwind-timeless-ve8020-bal-grant/7095), the inactive [Timeless VeBalGrant](https://etherscan.io/address/0x89f67f3054bfd662971854190dbc18dcabb416f6) still has approximately **10,286.807445 USDC** in unclaimed FeeDistributor rewards. These were not recovered by BIP-925 because `withdrawBalances()` only handles BAL and WETH.

The DAO multisig can recover the USDC by atomically calling `claimFees(FeeDistributor, USDC, DAO, 0)` four times. This is necessary because the grant has accumulated more than 60 weeks of unclaimed USDC, while the FeeDistributor settles at most 20 weeks per call.

# Technical Specifications

There is a PR with the DAO Safe payload and successful simulations available at https://github.com/balancer/multisig-ops/pull/2882
